mentions.name: Feedbun
mentions.description: A browser extension that decodes food labels and recipes on any website to support healthy eating, providing science-backed research summaries and recommendations. Built with Elixir/Phoenix using bespoke LLM fleets for production workflows, with a React Native (Expo) companion mobile app for use while shopping in person.
